detail: Your custom ground fleet will depend on compatible physical stores. Review the Ammunition tab before activating: manufacturing orders that have not completed cannot supply combat.
requirements: Activation changes how custom ground weapons receive ammunition. It cannot be switched back to free shared supply; prepare compatible stocks first. Inherited equipment retains its share of the existing magazine.
Consumption is planned across all conserved deployments once. Empty stores limit firing; mobility and observation retain their separate operational roles. Extra stock grants no standing-force bonus.
